descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: more than four sessions (retention never keeps that many); nearest TFA-92594 AC 1.

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S07 More than four sessions fold into 'Earlier sessions' chunks of three, with summed line counts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'. (TFA-92594 AC 1)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Tim's chromium test: five '(prior)' sessions (Sep 19-23, 1 or 2 lines each) and no current transcript

When Open the Encounter tab; open the first chunk, then the second

Then Two 'Earlier sessions' rows ('4 lines', '3 lines'); an open chunk shows each session under its own label; one chunk open at a time

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: groups toHaveCount(2), toContainText '4 lines' / '3 lines' (U3 summed count), per-session labels visible only inside the open chunk, aria-expanded (T1: prototype :6697-6710). The test seeds five days with no archivedAt and asserts all five are listed: it supports the T1 grouping only and shows the U6a risk; it is not evidence for U6. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
